title: ingest.put_geoip_database

name.description: The provider-assigned name of the IP geolocation database to download.

maxmind.description:
The configuration necessary to identify which IP geolocation provider to use to download the database, as well as any provider-specific configuration necessary for such downloading.
At present, the only supported provider is maxmind, and the maxmind provider requires that an account_id (string) is configured.

master_timeout.description:
Period to wait for a connection to the master node.
If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.

timeout.description: Period to wait for a response. If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.

id.description: ID of the database configuration to create or update.

description:
Create or update a GeoIP database configuration.

Refer to the create or update IP geolocation database configuration API.
